notes: P02 DIMVA-X03_benign_gen deliverable for venue dimva: evaluation/venue2027/dimva/benign_fault_generator.py implements the exact generate_benign(seed, workload) -> Campaign contract, producing deterministic PHI-free BENIGN fault sessions over the five registered fault types rate_limit_retry, network_retry, ux_confusion_retry, consent_edit and delayed_timestamps — realistic nonmalicious retries that superficially resemble probing (rate-limit bursts resemble burst_probe pacing, network backoffs resemble replay probing, mis-scoped UX confusion purposes resemble purpose_probe, consent/epoch edits resemble scope rotation, long legitimate stalls resemble low-and-slow horizons) while never violating an authorization invariant (campaign_label=BENIGN, violated_invariant=NONE, campaign level only). VOLUME PARITY (critical property): generate_benign accepts a target event-volume/cadence profile WorkloadProfile(tenant, target_events, pace_bucket_lo, pace_bucket_hi); the emitted campaign contains EXACTLY target_events events (one baseline plus the fault repertoire filling the remaining budget via a deterministic seed-rotated allocation) and every non-delayed inter-arrival gap lies inside the requested cadence profile; over-production is structurally refused fail closed with VOLUME_BUDGET_EXCEEDED whenever the budget is below the minimum realizable genuine-repertoire campaign (MIN_TARGET_EVENTS = 1 baseline + 2 rate-limit retries + 2 network retries + 2 UX confusion retries + 1 consent edit + 1 delayed stall, so the benign arm always contains real repeated attempts and is never trivially easy), proving volume parity is mechanically enforced rather than conventional. Every event is exactly the seven-field minimal surface of research/venue2027/dimva/protocols/event.schema.json (actor/scope opaque SHA-256 hex digests, coarse snake_case tool token, boolean allowed, closed purpose enum, 60 s bucket ts, opaque camp-<16 hex> campaign_id), asserted in tests by validating every generated event against the frozen schema through the shared stdlib validator schema_validator.validate_instance. LABELS EXIST ONLY AT CAMPAIGN LEVEL: events are built through the shared campaign_generator._make_event builder, which structurally refuses any label-like field with EVENT_LABEL_FIELD_FORBIDDEN, and the seven-field gate fails closed with EVENT_FIELD_MISMATCH, so no event ever carries ground truth and tenant/family/label/invariant strings never appear inside event payloads (template-leak-safe across splits). Determinism: all entropy derives from SHA-256 digests over stable coordinate strings (generator version, seed, tenant, target volume, fault index) — no random module, no clock, no environment reads; same (seed, workload) yields byte-identical to_dict output. Fail-closed error surface: stable reason codes INVALID_SEED, INVALID_TENANT, INVALID_WORKLOAD, VOLUME_BUDGET_EXCEEDED, CADENCE_PROFILE_VIOLATED, PHI_FIELD_PRESENT, EVENT_LABEL_FIELD_FORBIDDEN, EVENT_FIELD_MISMATCH; a fail-closed post-build volume/cadence gate re-verifies exact budget conformance and cadence-profile membership (delayed-timestamp stalls are the only admissible class beyond the profile, disjoint from profile bounds by construction: MAX_PACE_GAP_BUCKETS=12 < DELAYED_GAP_MIN_BUCKETS=30); no clear-text principals, no reason codes on the event surface, no live provider. test_benign_fault_generator.py (56 tests): positive vectors cover BENIGN labeling with invariant NONE across seeds, determinism/idempotence across call order, seed sensitivity, every benign fault type present in one campaign (denials confined to retry segments, single actor, multi-purpose/multi-scope churn, delayed stalls beyond the profile), EXACT volume parity for budgets spanning MIN_TARGET_EVENTS..MAX_TARGET_EVENTS and volume-matching to every attack family's stage range in campaign_generator.FAMILY_SPECS, cadence-profile conformance across seeds and pace bounds, frozen-schema conformance of every event, opaque leak-free campaign_id and JSON serializability of both WorkloadProfile and Campaign; adversarial vectors prove a benign campaign exceeding the requested volume budget is refused (all budgets below MIN_TARGET_EVENTS raise VOLUME_BUDGET_EXCEEDED without silent trimming, so volume parity is enforced), per-event label fields are refused (all five label-like names), off-schema fields refused, non-WorkloadProfile and malformed targets/cadence bounds refused with INVALID_WORKLOAD, invalid seeds/tenants refused, PHI-like tenant refused, tampered campaigns fail the volume and cadence gates, all generated campaigns PHI-free and reason-code-free on the event surface.
